description.p: Claude Desktop packaged as a Flatpak from Anthropic's official Linux .deb. It provides the Chat, Cowork, and Claude Code experience in a single desktop app: parallel sessions, visual diff review, an integrated terminal and editor, and live app preview.
This is an unofficial repackage. The application is downloaded, unmodified, from Anthropic's signed .deb and run under zypak inside the Flatpak sandbox.
